information_budget.observation_window: One hourly origin: first native observation within first15min. Forecast nominal1hour, score nearest native target within5min, same calendar day, no interpolation. Causal lag<=origin−1hour within15min. Latest20percent native dates per stream reserved. Native response outliers retained. Expanded information budget: T_now, T_lag, T_external, T_external_lag, RH_external, hour_sin, hour_cos, stream
information_budget.calibration_and_history: See frozen development protocol and per-fold states; all learned calibration is training-partition-only. T and Te are current internal/external Celsius temperatures; T−1 is a causal one-hour lag, He is current external relative humidity percent, and v is external vapor-pressure deficit in kPa. Five offsets c_s are−0.384543,−0.316614,−0.340834,+0.138741,+0.323654degC in rules.json sensor order. Coefficients ba=−0.002878, br=0.050874, bm=0.083403 are dimensionless; bv=0.481876degC/kPa and bvr=0.084243/kPa. The reference30degC is an algebraic centering constant, not a prescribed biological setpoint.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
